CeruleanCity_Text_RivalIntro:
{RIVAL}: Yo! {PLAYER}!
You're still struggling along back here?
I'm doing great! I caught a bunch of strong and smart POKéMON!
Here, let me see what you caught, {PLAYER}!
CeruleanCity_Text_RivalDefeat: Hey! Take it easy! You won already!
CeruleanCity_Text_RivalPostBattle:
{RIVAL}: Hey, guess what?
I went to BILL's and got him to show me his rare POKéMON.
That added a lot of pages to my POKéDEX!
After all, BILL's world famous as a POKéMANIAC.
He invented the POKéMON Storage System on PC, too.
Since you're using his system, you should go thank him.
Well, I better get rolling! Smell ya later!
CeruleanCity_Text_OhRightLittlePresentAs:
Oh, yeah, right.
I feel sorry for you. No, really. You're always plodding behind me.
So here, I'll give you a little present as a favor.
CeruleanCity_Text_ExplainFameCheckerSmel:
A chatty gossip like you… That thing's perfect.
I don't need it because I don't give a hoot about others.
All right, this time I really am gone. Smell ya!
CeruleanCity_Text_RivalVictory: なんたって！ おれは　てんさい　だからよ！
CeruleanCity_Text_GruntDefeat: GRUNT: Stop! I give up! I'll leave quietly!
CeruleanCity_Text_OkayIllReturnStolenTM: …Okay. I'll return the TM I stole.
CeruleanCity_Text_RecoveredTM28FromGrunt: {PLAYER} recovered TM28 from the TEAM ROCKET GRUNT.
CeruleanCity_Text_MakeRoomForThisCantRun: Make room for this! I can't run until I give it to you!
CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerLifeIsToughIsnt:
You're a TRAINER, too?
Collecting, battling… It's a tough life, isn't it?
CeruleanCity_Text_YouCanCutDownSmallTree:
Did you know that you can CUT down small trees?
Even that small tree in front of the shop can be CUT down.
I think there's a way around it, though.
CeruleanCity_Text_IfSlowbroWasntThereCou:
If that SLOWBRO wasn't there, you could CUT down the small tree.
That way, you could get to the other side.
I think there's a way around it, though.
CeruleanCity_Text_PokemonEncyclopediaAmu: You're making an encyclopedia on POKéMON? That sounds amusing.
CeruleanCity_Text_PeopleHereWereRobbed:
The people here were robbed.
It's obvious that TEAM ROCKET is behind this most heinous crime!
Even our POLICE FORCE has trouble with the ROCKETS!
CeruleanCity_Text_HardToControlMonsObedi:
No! That's wrong! It's so hard to control POKéMON!
Your POKéMON's obedience depends on your abilities as a TRAINER.
CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle:
I want a bright red bicycle.
I'll keep it at home, so it won't get dirty.
CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave:
This is CERULEAN CAVE.
Horribly strong POKéMON live inside there.
It takes a very special TRAINER to be allowed inside there.
You'd have to be strong enough to become the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION for starters.
And, you would have to have made a great achievement.
CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign: CERULEAN CITY A Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds It
CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems:
TRAINER TIPS
A POKéMON can be made to hold an item.
Some items can even be used by the holding POKéMON in battle.
CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign: Grass and caves handled easily! BIKE SHOP
CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign: CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: MISTY The Tomboyish Mermaid!
